description: This file defines a GUI dialog class for managing behavioral observation sessions in the BORIS software. It includes methods for adding media files, data files, images, extracting audio, checking parameters, and plotting data, as well as handling user interactions and validation for setting up observations.

classes.name: AssignConverter
classes.description: A dialog for assigning converters to specific columns in data visualization.

classes.name: Observation
classes.description: Main dialog class for setting up and managing behavioral observations, including media and data management, parameter validation, and plotting.

methods.name: check_media_creation_date
methods.description: Checks if all media files have creation date metadata, searches in metadata and filenames.

methods.name: cb_time_offset_changed
methods.description: Enables or disables the time offset widget based on checkbox state.

methods.name: use_media_file_name_as_obsid
methods.description: Sets observation ID based on the first media file's filename.

methods.name: use_img_dir_as_obsid
methods.description: Sets observation ID based on the first selected images directory.

methods.name: obs_type_changed
methods.description: Switches UI based on selected observation type (media, live, images).

methods.name: add_images_directory
methods.description: Adds a directory of images to the observation, with path validation.

methods.name: remove_images_directory
methods.description: Removes selected images directory from the list.

methods.name: add_button_menu
methods.description: Recursively adds menu items from a data structure to a QMenu.

methods.name: limit_time_interval
methods.description: Prompts user to set a start and stop time for observation.

methods.name: tw_data_files_cellDoubleClicked
methods.description: Handles double-click on data files table to assign converters.

methods.name: plot_data_file
methods.description: Creates and displays a plot for selected data file.

methods.name: not_editable_column_color
methods.description: Returns a color for non-editable table columns.

methods.name: add_data_file
methods.description: Adds a data file to the observation, with validation and preview.

methods.name: view_data_file_head_tail
methods.description: Displays first and last rows of a data file.

methods.name: extract_wav
methods.description: Extracts WAV audio from media files loaded in the first player.

methods.name: check_creation_date
methods.description: Verifies existence and metadata of media files, especially creation date tags.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the dialog is closed.

methods.name: pbCancel_clicked
methods.description: Cancels the observation setup process.

methods.name: check_parameters
methods.description: Validates all observation parameters before starting.

methods.name: pbLaunch_clicked
methods.description: Starts the observation if parameters are valid.

methods.name: pbSave_clicked
methods.description: Saves the observation setup if parameters are valid.

methods.name: check_media
methods.description: Analyzes media files for duration, format, and metadata.

methods.name: update_media_options
methods.description: Enables or disables media-related UI options based on loaded media.

methods.name: add_media
methods.description: Adds media files or directories to the observation, with validation.

methods.name: add_media_to_listview
methods.description: Adds a media file entry to the list view with associated info.

methods.name: remove_data_file
methods.description: Removes selected data files from the list.

methods.name: remove_media
methods.description: Removes selected media files from the list.
